Scenario Summary: Successful room booking with valid guest details
Gherkin BDD Scenario (Given-When-Then):
Scenario: User successfully books a room with valid guest details
  Given User is on the room reservation page with available stay dates
  When User clicks the 'Reserve Now' button on the price summary card
  And User enters valid guest information (Alexander, QAUser, alex.qa@test.com, 0812345678901)
  And User clicks the 'Reserve Now' button inside the modal
  Then The reservation should be created successfully with HTTP 201
  And User should see the 'Booking Confirmed' card displaying the reserved dates
Expected Result: Booking is confirmed successfully (HTTP 201), confirmation card displays check-in/out dates, and 'Return home' button is visible.

Scenario Summary: Submit booking modal with all mandatory fields empty
Gherkin BDD Scenario (Given-When-Then):
Scenario: System displays validation errors when submitting an empty booking form
  Given User has opened the booking reservation modal
  When User leaves all input fields empty (firstname, lastname, email, phone)
  And User clicks the 'Reserve Now' button inside the modal
  Then The form submission should be rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
  And User should see a validation alert banner containing mandatory field requirements
Expected Result: Form is not submitted (HTTP 400), red validation banner appears containing specific errors for blank Firstname, Lastname, Email, and Phone.

Scenario Summary: Submit booking with Name below minimum boundary (2 chars)
Gherkin BDD Scenario (Given-When-Then):
Scenario: System rejects guest names below minimum boundary limit (< 3 characters)
  Given User has opened the booking reservation modal
  When User enters Firstname 'Jo' and Lastname 'Do' (2 characters each)
  And User enters valid email and phone number
  And User clicks the 'Reserve Now' button inside the modal
  Then The form submission should be rejected
  And User should see validation error 'size must be between 3 and 18'
Expected Result: Validation error is triggered indicating name size must be between 3 and 18 characters. Form is not submitted.

Scenario Summary: Attempt to book dates that overlap with an existing confirmed booking
Gherkin BDD Scenario (Given-When-Then):
Scenario: System prevents double-booking when selected dates overlap with an existing reservation
  Given Room '101' already has a confirmed booking for dates '2026-11-10' to '2026-11-12'
  When Another guest attempts to book Room '101' for the overlapping dates
  And The guest submits valid guest information
  Then The backend API should reject the booking with HTTP 409 Conflict
  And The UI should display a graceful alert indicating the dates are unavailable
  And The application must NOT crash to an unhandled error boundary screen
Expected Result: System rejects booking with HTTP 409 Conflict. UI displays a clear, graceful error banner stating 'Room is unavailable for the selected dates'.

Gherkin BDD Scenario (Given-When-Then):
Scenario: User successfully books a room for minimum stay duration (1 night)
  Given User is on the booking calendar for an available room
  When User selects check-in date '2026-11-20' and check-out date '2026-11-21' (1 night)
  Then The price breakdown should calculate exactly '1 night x rate' plus cleaning and service fees
  When User submits valid guest details in the reservation modal
  Then The booking should be confirmed for a 1-night stay
Expected Result: Price calculation shows 1 night x rate + cleaning fee + service fee. Reservation succeeds.

Scenario Summary: Attempt to select Check-out date prior to Check-in date (Reverse dates)
Gherkin BDD Scenario (Given-When-Then):
Scenario: System blocks reservation when check-out date is set earlier than check-in date
  Given User is on the booking calendar for an available room
  When User sets check-out date '2026-11-01' earlier than check-in date '2026-11-05'
  Then The calendar should prevent the selection OR form submission should be blocked
  And User should see error message 'Check-out date must be after check-in date'
Expected Result: Date picker disallows earlier checkout OR form validation blocks submission with 'Check-out date must be after Check-in date'.

Scenario Summary: Submit booking containing purely alphabetic string in Phone number
Gherkin BDD Scenario (Given-When-Then):
Scenario: System validates phone number format to reject alphabetical characters
  Given User has opened the booking reservation modal
  When User enters valid guest name and email
  And User enters alphabetical characters 'abcdefghijk12' in the phone input
  And User clicks the 'Reserve Now' button inside the modal
  Then The form submission should be rejected
  And User should see validation error 'Phone number must contain only valid numeric digits'
Expected Result: Form validation rejects non-numeric phone format with 'Phone must contain valid phone digits'.
